title: statuses/<id>.json
description: A buff, debuff or hidden effect on a unit.

limit.description: how many units can hold it from you at once. Applying it to another takes it off the oldest

group.description: only one status of this group can be on a unit: a new one replaces the old. With no duration it lasts until replaced

keptBy.description: with breaksOn action: using one of these abilities, by id from the same class, or with one of these tags, doesn't break it

consumedBy.description: it ends when the holder uses one of these abilities, by id from the same class, or with this tag

uses.description: how many uses it lasts, 1 by default. These aren't stacks: its effects don't scale with them

stacks.description: takes this many stacks each use, instead of ending

set.description: modify: makes it this. Applied before `add` and `multiply`

spendsStack.description: trigger: takes a stack of this status, or of the one named, each time it fires

of.description: trigger: whose events it watches, the holder's by default

notOnHolder.description: trigger: not when the event landed on the holder

softCap.description: periodic: past this many hit, those hit share this many's worth

perTargetHit.description: modify, with change: this share more for each one the ability hits, or for cost this much more

maxTotal.description: with perTargetHit: the most it can come to

addAmount.description: modify: adds this amount, for one worked out in the fight

byMissingHealth.description: stat, modify: grows as health falls

drain.description: periodic: heals the caster by this share of what it does

from.description: store: whose damage or healing it keeps, the caster's by default

share.description: store: how much of it it keeps

into.description: transform: shows the holder with the look of this unit, by id from the same class

addTags.description: modify: tags the abilities also count as having

mastery.description: stat: the change grows by this many percent for each point of the holder's mastery percentage. modify: the same for what `change` picks. trigger: this many percent added to `chance` for each point

category.description: periodic: a word the class picks, like bleed or disease. On a stat or trigger: only for that category

categories.description: stat or trigger: only for these categories

every.description: periodic: seconds between ticks. trigger: it fires only on every this-many-th time, or for spend every this many points

resetOn.description: trigger with every: this event starts the count over, like nonCrit for two crits in a row

resource.description: trigger, for spend: only spending this resource, by key

all.description: immune: to all damage and harmful effects

hit.description: stat, trigger or modify: only for this kind of hit

source.description: stat or trigger: whose it is, the holder's by default

atTargets.description: trigger or modify: only when the ability hits at least this many

casterOnly.description: stat or trigger, on a status you put on someone: only for what passes between its holder and the one who applied it

atStacks.description: trigger, for statusGained or statusConsumed: only when the status has at least this many stacks

atMax.description: trigger, for statusGained: only when the status reaches its maxStacks

resets.description: trigger, with atStacks or atMax: takes the stacks off when it fires

full.description: trigger, for channelEnd: only when the channel runs its whole length

pickup.description: trigger, for pickup or overheal: only this kind of pickup

chancePerSpent.description: trigger: more chance for each point the ability spends

addPerSpent.description: stat: `add` more for each point the ability that applied it spent

multiplyPerSpent.description: stat: added to `multiply` for each point the ability that applied it spent

abilities.description: modify: the abilities it changes. trigger: only for these. By id, from the same class

tag.description: modify: changes every ability with this tag. trigger: only for abilities with this tag

statuses.description: modify: the statuses it changes. trigger: only for these. By id, from the same class

change.description: modify: what changes, one of cost, cooldown, cooldownRate, tickRate, channelDuration, channelTicks, castTime, charges, range, radius, maxTargets, duration, damage, healing, critChance, critDamage, maxStacks, mastery, every, others, stacks, amount, absorb, lockout, cone, distance, limit, uses, delay, or a param its target names

addEffects.description: modify: effects the abilities also do

statusEffects.description: modify of `statuses`: effects they also have

overrides.description: modify: replaces these keys of the status's or ability's definition, for things that aren't numbers. null removes one

ignores.description: modify of abilities: they can be used through these

param.description: names this effect's number, so a modify can change it

radius.description: aura: how far it reaches, in feet

status.description: aura: the status those inside have while they stay

notes.description: free-form notes on intent and backstory; the game never reads them
